entities.summary: George Winthrop "Dixie" Fish was an American rugby union player who competed in the 1920 Summer Olympics. Fish was a graduate of Cal/Berkeley and Columbia Medical School, later became a noted urologist, and supervised several professional organizations. Fish was a member of the American rugby union team, which won the gold medal at the Olympic Games.
